Commercial Director / Creative

From performing on screen to working behind the camera, I have experienced filmmaking from many perspectives.

After graduating with a degree in acting, I worked in editing, cinematography, creative development and on-set direction. Today, I direct commercials.

I observe closely to bring out the character of people and products on screen.
